11200.full:
αὐθεντέω, -ῶ
(αὐθέντης, i.e. αὐτο- ἕντης, one who acts on his own authority, in π., an autocrat; cf. Wis.12:6; cf. -ία, 3Ma.2:29; -ικος is frequently in vernacular, MM, see word)
to govern, exercise authority over: 1Ti.2:12.†
(AS)

s: to reach after, grasp at, aspire to
11202.full:
ὀρέγω
[in Sm.: Job.8:20, Eze.16:49 * ;]
to reach, stretch out; pass. and mid., to stretch oneself out, reach forth; metaphorically, to reach after, grasp at, aspire to: with genitive of thing(s), 1Ti.3:1, Heb.11:16; φιλαργυρίας (see Ellic. and CGT, in l), 1Ti.6:10.†
SYN.: ἐπιθυμέω, to desire (which see) (AS)

11203.full:
ἀν-επί-λημπτος (Rec. -λμπτος; Bl., § 6, 8), -ον
(ἀ- ἐπιλαμβάνω)
without reproach: 1Ti.3:2 5:7 6:14.†
SYN.: ἀμεμπτος, ἀνέγκλητος. It is stronger than these, for it implies not only that the man is of good report, but that he is deservedly so (cf. MM, VGT, see word). (AS)

11204.full:
νηφάλιος (-λεος, Rec., in 1Ti, ll. with), -ον (in cl., -α, -ον),
(νήφω),
__1. in cl., of drink, not mixed with wine.
__2. In later writers (Plut., al.), of persons, sober, temperate: 1Ti.3:2 3:11, Tit.2:2.†
(AS)

11207.full:
πάρ-οινος, -ον
= cl., παροινικός (παρά, οἶνος),
given to wine, drunken: 1Ti.3:3, Tit.1:7.†
(AS)

11208.full:
πλήκτης, -ου, ὁ
(πλήσσω), [in Sm.: Psa.35:15 * ;]
a striker, brawler: 1Ti.3:3, Tit.1:7 (Arist., Plut., al.).†
(AS)

11209.full:
ἄμαχος, -ον
(μάχη);
__1. invincible (frequently in cl.).
__2. abstaining from fighting, non-combatant (Xen.). Metaphorical (cf. MM, VGT, see word), not contentious: 1Ti.3:3, Tit.3:2.†
(AS)

s: without love of money, not avaricious
11210.full:
ἀ-φιλ-άργυρος, -ον
without love of money, not avaricious; 1Ti.3:3, Heb.13:5. (For other instances, see MM, see word)†
(AS)

s: to puff up, becloud with pride
11211.full:
τυφόω, -ῶ
(τῦφος, smoke; metaphorically, conceit),
prop., to wrap in smoke; used only metaphorically, to puff up, becloud with pride: pass., 1Ti.3:6 6:4, 2Ti.3:4 (Dem., Arist., al.).†
(AS)

11212.full:
διλογος, -ον
(δίς, λέγω),
__1. in sense of διλογεῖν, -ία (Xen.), given to repetition.
__2. In NT, prob. (cf. δίγλωσσος, Pro.11:13, Sir.5:9) double-tongued: 1Ti.3:8.†
(AS)

11217.full:
καυστηριάζω (Rec. καυτηρ-, and so usually in Gk. writers, see Soph., Lex., see word)
to mark by branding, brand (AV, scar, but see CGT, in l): metaphorically, pass. pf. ptcp., 1Ti.4:2 (cf. καυτήριον, 4Ma.15:22 *).†
(AS)

11219.full:
ἀπό-βλητος, -ον
(ἀποβάλλω), [in Aq.: Lev.7:18, al.; Sm.: Hos.9:3 (טָמֵא) ;]
to be thrown away, rejected: 1Ti.4:4 (Hom., Plut.).†
(AS)

11220.full:
ἐν-τρέφω
to train up, nurture; pass., metaphorically, τοῖς λόγοις τ. πίστεως, 1Ti.4:6.†
(AS)

11222.full:
ὠφέλιμος, -ον
(ὠφελέω),
useful, serviceable, profitable: with dative commod., Tit.3:8; before πρός, with accusative, 1Ti.4:8, 2Ti.3:16.†
(AS)

11223.full:
ἐπι-πλήσσω
__1. to strike at, to punish.
__2. to rebuke, reprove: 1Ti.5:1.†
(AS)

11224.full:
ἀμοιβή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀμείβομαι, to repay); [in Aq., Sm.: Pro.12:14, al. ;]
requital, recompense: 1Ti.5:4 (for illustration from τ.. see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

11225.full:
μονόω, -ῶ
(μόνος), [in Aq.: Gen.49:6 ;]
to leave alone, forsake: of a childless widow, pf. ptcp. pass., 1Ti.5:5.†
(AS)

11226.full:
τεκνο-τροφέω, -ῶ
to rear young (of bees, Arist.),
to bring up children: 1Ti.5:10.†
(AS)

11227.full:
ξενοδοχέω late Gk. for -κέω
(ξένος, δέχομαι),
to entertain strangers: 1Ti.5:10.†
(AS)

11231.full:
πρό-κριμα, -τος, τό
(cl. προκρίνειν, 1. to prefer. 2. to judge beforehand),
pre-judging, prejudice: 1Ti.5:21 (see Cremer, 378).†
(AS)

11233.full:
ὑδροποτίω, -ῶ
(ὕδωρ, πίνω), [in LXX: Dan LXX 1:12 שָׁתָה מַיִם) * ;]
to drink water, opposite to οἴνῳ χρῆσθαι: 1Ti.5:23 (Hdt., i, 71; Plat., Rep., 561 with, al.).†
(AS)

s: of the opening of the stomach
11234.full:
στόμαχος, -ου, ὁ
(στόμα),
prop., a mouth, an opening;
__(a) in early Gk. writers, the throat;
__(b) of the opening of the stomach (Arist.);
__(with) in later writers (Plut., al.), the stomach: 1Ti.5:23.†
(AS)

11236.full:
παρα-δια-τριβή, -ῆς, ἡ
useless wrangling: seel. in Rec. for διαπαρατριβή (which see), 1Ti.6:5.†
δια-παρα-τριβή, -ῆς, ἡ
(παρατριβή, friction, irritation)
mutual irritation (Field, Notes, 211), wrangling: 1Ti.6:5 (Rec. παραδιατριβή).†
(AS)

11237.full:
σκέπασμα, -τος, τό
(σκεπάζω, to cover),
a covering, esp. clothing: 1Ti.6:8.†
(AS)

s: to put on a spit, hence, to pierce
11238.full:
περι-πείρω
to put on a spit, hence, to pierce: metaphorically, ἑαυτὸν . . . ὀδύναις, 1Ti.6:10.†
(AS)

11239.full:
gentleness, meekness
Some manuscripts list πραότης (G4236) in place of G6073 at 1Ti.6.11

11240.full:
ἄ-σπιλος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., σπῖλος) [in Sm.: Job.15:15 (LXX, καθαρός)* ;]
spotless, unstained: 1Pe.1:19; metaphorically, 1Ti.6:14, Jas.1:27, 2Pe.3:14 (for exx., see MM, see word).†
SYN.: ἀμίαντος, ἄμωμος (AS)

11242.full:
ὑψηλο- φρονέω, -ῶ
= μευαλοφρονεῖν (Xen., Plat., al.),
to be high-minded: 1Ti.6:17 (WH, mg., ὑψηλὰ, φρονεῖν).†
(AS)

11244.full:
εὐ-μετά-δοτος, -ον
(εὖ, μεταδιδωμι),
ready to impart: assoc. with κοινωνικός (for the distinction between the two, see Field, Notes, 213; CGT, in l), 1Ti.6:18.†
(AS)

11245.full:
κοινωνικός, -ή, -όν
(κοινωνία),
__1. sociable.
__2. ready to com­municate or impart (R, mg., ready to sympathize, see Field, Notes, 213 f.): 1Ti.6:18.†
(AS)

11246.full:
κενοφωνία, -ας, ἡ
(κενός, φωνέω), [cf. κενολογέω (צָפַף), Isa.8:19 * ;]
empty talk, babbling: pl., 1Ti.6:20, 2Ti.2:16.†
(AS)

s: under a false name, falsely called
11248.full:
ψευδώνυμος, -ον
(ψευδής, ὄνομα)
under a false name, falsely called: 1Ti.6:20 (Æsch., Plut., a1.).†
(AS)

11251.full:
σωφρονισμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(σωφρονίζω),
__(a) an admonishing (F1J, Plut., al.);
__(b) self-control, self-discipline: 2Ti.1:7 (on the reflexive meaning here, see Ellic., in l).†
(AS)

s: to bear evil treatment along with, take one's share of ill-treatment
11252.full:
συν-κακοπαθέω (Rec. συγκ-), -ῶ,
to bear evil treatment along with, take one's share of ill-treatment: 2Ti.2:3; with dative commod., τ. εὐαγγελίῳ, 2Ti.2:18.†
(AS)

s: to levy a troop, enlist soldiers
11256.full:
στρατολογέω, -ῶ
(στρατός, λέγω),
to levy a troop, enlist soldiers: 2Ti.2:4 (Diod., Plut., al.).†
(AS)

11257.full:
ἀθλέω, -ῶ (in cl. also ἀθλεύω, ἆθλος, a contest, in war or in sport),
to contend in games, wrestle, combat: 2Ti.2:5.†
(AS)

s: not to be put to shame

11260.full:
γάγγραινα, -ης, ἡ,
a gangrene, an eating sore, which leads to mortification: 2Ti.2:17.†
(AS)

11262.full:
ἤπιος, -α, -ον
mild, gentle: 1Th.2:7 (WH, R, mg., νήπιος); before πρός, 2Ti.2:24.†
(AS)

11263.full:
ἀνεξί-κακος, -ον
(fut., ἀνέξομαι, κακός)
patiently forbearing (cf. ἀνεξικακία, Wis.2:19; and see MM, VGT, see word): 2Ti.2:24.†
(AS)

s: in mid, to place oneself in opposition, oppose
11264.full:
ἀντι-δια-τίθημι
in mid, to place oneself in opposition, oppose: 2Ti.2:25 (EV; but see Field, Notes, 215 f.; cf. MM, VGT, see word)
(AS)

11266.full:
φίλ-αυτος, -ον
loving oneself (Arist.); in bad sense (ib.), selfish: 2Ti.3:2.†
SYN.: αὐθάδης (see Tr., Syn., § xciii) (AS)

11267.full:
ἄσπονδος, -ον
(σπονδή, a libation);
__1. without truce (Thuc.).
__2. admitting of no truce, implacable (Dem., al.): 2Ti.3:3.†
(AS)

11269.full:
ἀ-φιλ-άγαθος, -ον
without love of good: 2Ti.3:3 (not elsewhere in Gk. lit., but see MM, see word).†
(AS)

s: to put on oneself, be clothed with
11272.full:
ἐν-δύνω, see: ἐνδύω.
ἐν-δύω
(ἐνδύνω, 2Ti.3:6), [in LXX chiefly for לָבַשׁ ;]
__1. with accusative of person(s), Mat.27:28 (WH, mg., R, mg.); with dupl. accusative, Mat.27:31, Mrk.15:20, Luk.15:22; mid., to put on oneself, be clothed with: with accusative of thing(s), Mat.6:25, Mrk.6:9, Luk.8:27 12:22, Act.12:21; ptcp., Mat.22:11, Mrk.1:6, 2Co.5:3, Rev.1:13 15:6 19:14; of armour (figuratively): Rom.13:12, Eph.6:11, 14, 1Th.5:8; metaphorically, δύναμιν, Luk.24:49; ἀφθαρσίαν, ἀθανασίαν, 1Co.15:53-54; τ. καινὸν ἄνθρωπον, Eph 4:24, Col.3:10; σπλάγχνα οἰκτιρμοῦ, Col.3:12; Ἰησ. Χριστόν, Rom.13:14, Gal.3:27,
__2. to enter, press into: 2Ti.3:6 (cf. ἐπ-ενδύω).†
(AS)

11273.full:
γυναικάριον, -ου, τό (diminutive of γυνή),
a little woman; contemptuously, a silly woman (EV): 2Ti.3:6.†
(AS)

11276.full:
γόης, -ητος, ὁ (γοάω, to wail),
__1. a wailer.
__2. a wizard.
__3. an impostor (cf. γοητεία, trickery, 2Ma.12:24): 2Ti.3:13.
† (AS)

11278.full:
ἀκαίρως, adv.
(ἄκαιρος, unseasonable), [in LXX: Si 35 (32):4 * ;]
out of season, unseasonably: opposite to εὐκαίρως (which see), 2Ti.4:2 (cf. Cremer, 740; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

11280.full:
κνήθω
(late form of κνάω),
__1. to scratch.
__2. to tickle; pass., to itch: 2Ti.4:3.†
(AS)

11281.full:
ἀνά-λυσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀναλύω),
a loosing, e.g. of a vessel from its moorings, hence, departure: from life, 2Ti.4:6.†
(AS)

11283.full:
Δαλματία (L, Δελ-), -ας, ἡ
Dalmatia, a part of Illyria on E. coast of the Adriatic: 2Ti.4:10.†
(AS)

11284.full:
φελόνης (Rec. φαιλ-), -ου, ὁ
by metath. for παινόλης (also φενόλης, φαινόλιον; Lat. pænula)
a cloak (see DCG, i, 338; on the idea that the meaning here is book-cover, see CGT, in l; Milligan, NTD, 20; Field, Notes, 217 f., where the view that the φ. here is an eccl. vestment is discussed): 2Ti.4:13.†
(AS)

11288.full:
Πούδης
(in π., genitive -εντος, see Zorell, see word), ὁ (Latin)
Pudens: 2Ti.4:21.†
(AS)

11292.full:
φρεναπάτης, -ου, ὁ
(φρήν, ἀπάτη),
a deceiver (B1., deceiver of his own mind, § 28, 5.2, where see ref. to π.): Tit.1:10 (eccl.).†
(AS)

s: to stop the mouth, to silence
11293.full:
ἐπι-στομίζω
(στόμα),
to bridle; metaphorically, to stop the mouth, to silence: Tit.1:11.†
(AS)

s: a teacher of that which is good
11294.full:
καλο-διδάσκαλος, -ου, ὁ
a teacher of that which is good: Tit.2:3.†
(AS)

11295.full:
σωφρονίζω
[in Aq.: Isa.38:16 * ;]
to make σώφρων, recall one to his senses, control (RV, train): with accusative of person(s), Tit.2:4.†
(AS)

s: Of a wife, loving her husband
11296.full:
φίλανδρος, -ον
__1. loving men (Æsch.).
__2. Of a wife, loving her husband (frequently in epitaphs, see LS, see word, Deiss., BS, 255): Tit.2:4.†
(AS)

11297.full:
οἰκουργός, -όν
(οἶκος + root of ἔργον),
working at home: Tit.2:5 (Rec. οἰκουρός, which see).†
(AS)

11298.full:
κοσμικός, -ή, -όν
(κόσμος)
__1. pertaining to the world or universe.
__2. of this world, earthly. Heb.9:1.
__3. In ethical sense, worldly: ἐπιθυμίαι, Tit.2:12.†
(AS)
